conventions: Begin every newly created .ts or .tsx file with the Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026 (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).
Format code with 2-space indentation, single quotes, trailing commas, and semicolons matching @backstage/cli/config/prettier.
Use named exports with explicit @public or @alpha TSDoc release tags on all exported symbols re-exported from package entrypoints.
Import useTranslationRef from @backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha in plugins/notifications components and consume notificationsTranslationRef.
Never add data-testid or test-only attributes or use *ByTestId queries in components or tests; use accessible roles, labels, and text with screen and findBy* queries.

In the new home card component, clean up any polling timers (clearInterval) and subscriptions created by the card in React useEffect cleanup functions on unmount; do not modify existing throttle or effect code in NotificationsPage or NotificationsTable.
Only import packages declared in the respective package.json dependencies, devDependencies, or peerDependencies.

decisions.topic: Live signal refresh and polling fallback in HomePageUnreadNotifications
decisions.choice: Subscribe via useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications'); refresh on new_notification, notification_read, or notification_unread actions; when isSignalsAvailable === false, poll with setInterval (default 10000ms, configurable via pollingIntervalMs prop) and clear interval on unmount
rejected: Polling unconditionally when signals are active
Ignoring notification_read and notification_unread signal actions
decisions.reason: Satisfies FR-5, FR-6, and NFR-6 by avoiding redundant polling when signals are active and cleaning up intervals on unmount.

decisions.choice: Link card items to `${notificationsRootRoute()}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}` via useRouteRef(rootRouteRef); read searchParams.get('id') in NotificationsPage (and as fallback in NotificationsTable via optional highlightedId prop) and apply visual styling via Table options.rowStyle and a CSS class on the matching row
rejected: Adding test-only DOM attributes or mutating backend filter API for highlighting
decisions.reason: Resolves routes through Backstage route refs and makes the highlighted row visually distinguishable through user-visible styling without test-only attributes or backend changes.

units.behaviour: Home-page card content component that fetches and displays the signed-in user's latest unread notifications with mark-as-read, deep-linking to /notifications?id=<id>, live signal updates, and polling fallback.
rules: 1. Start the file with the 2026 Backstage Apache-2.0 license header.
2. Export type HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps (@public) with optional limit?: number (default 5) and pollingIntervalMs?: number (default 10000).

3. Export function Content(props: HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps) (@public) that resolves notificationsRootRoute via useRouteRef(rootRouteRef), translations via useTranslationRef(notificationsTranslationRef), notificationsApi via useApi(notificationsApiRef), toastApi via useApi(toastApiRef), and signal state via const { lastSignal, isSignalsAvailable } = useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications').

4. Fetch unread notifications using useNotificationsApi(api => api.getNotifications({ read: false, limit, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }), [limit]) and maintain local displayed notifications state synced from value?.notifications (filtering out any notification IDs marked as read locally).
5. When lastSignal arrives with action 'new_notification', 'notification_read', or 'notification_unread', call retry() to refresh the unread list.

6. When isSignalsAvailable === false, set up a setInterval timer every pollingIntervalMs (when pollingIntervalMs > 0) that calls retry(), and do not start an interval when isSignalsAvailable is true; always call clearInterval(intervalId) in the useEffect cleanup function on unmount or dependency change.

7. Render <Progress /> from @backstage/core-components while initial data is loading, <ResponseErrorPanel error={error} /> when an error occurs, and <Text>{t('homeWidget.emptyMessage')}</Text> when there are no unread notifications to display.

8. For each unread notification, render its SeverityIcon, a <Link to={`${notificationsRootRoute()}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}`}>{notification.payload.title}</Link>, optional description, origin/topic/RelativeTime metadata, and a mark-as-read ButtonIcon (with aria-label={t('homeWidget.markAsRead')}) that calls notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [notification.id], read: true }), immediately removes notification.id from the displayed unread list, calls retry(), and posts a danger toast if updateNotifications fails.

rules: 1. Start with the 2026 Backstage Apache-2.0 license header.
